references.text: Moses commanded the Israelites to distribute the land as an inheritance among the tribes, which Joshua later completed.
Moses gave Joshua the task of leading the people into the land that the Lord had promised them.
The Lord's promise to Joshua to give him all the land he sets his foot on, just as He had promised Moses.
The land had rest from war after Joshua distributed it as an inheritance.
Summary of how the Lord gave Israel all the land He had sworn to give their fathers, and the land had rest.
The distribution of the land among the tribes after the land was subdued before them.
Instructions on how the land should be distributed as an inheritance among the tribes according to their size.
Hebrews refers to the fact that Joshua did not give them the final rest, and points toward a future Sabbath rest.
